name: Open-set negative attack on the fixed distinctive-token branch
question: Does one-edit distinctive-token matching create any false search-priority candidate on four exact-roster-absent Panoramax controls across three cities?

target_roster.entity_name: Département du Calvados - Direction de la Culture

name_token_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens

distinctive_edit_token_contract.apostrophe_or_token_fragment_rule: For a row with two or three normalized tokens, also test their concatenation; this converts p + tits to ptits without changing OCR text.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.evidence_weighting: Each distinct matched target token of length 6-7 contributes one unit; length >=8 contributes two units. A target matches at two units.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.uniqueness_rule: Emit a lexical search-priority candidate only when exactly one target in the frozen thirteen-target roster matches.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.association: Exact or Levenshtein-distance-one normalized token evidence only; witnesses union across the available governed observation sequence.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.authority: Search-priority candidate only; no token, sign, facade, entity, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, or safety authority.

execution_rule: Run once with the fixed successor. Do not tune on a false accept or reinterpret UNKNOWN as proof of safety.

claim_boundary.allowed: Development evidence about whether the fixed distinctive-token branch abstains on these four exact-thirteen-roster-absent, three-city Panoramax entrance-ray images. Pixels were used previously by the appearance branch, but this is the first governed OCR replay recorded for them.
not_allowed: fresh-pixel, formal open-set, conformal, FDR-controlled, calibrated-probability, arbitrary distribution-shift, deployment, or safety guarantees
UNKNOWN meaning negative, known-safe, or absence of all visually or lexically similar entities
exact identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, or user benefit
